title: Gluing monoid operations and a structural map on an existing set sheaf
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site with fibre products [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], and $\{U_a\to U\}_{a\in I}$ a covering family. Work in a universe containing the site, $I$, all section sets and the indexed products [def-weil-size-convention]. All restrictions are to localized slice sites [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. A sheaf of commutative monoids means a presheaf of commutative monoids whose underlying presheaf of sets is a sheaf; its morphisms are natural transformations preserving products and identity. Let $R$ be such a sheaf on $\mathcal C/U$. For every $a$, let $F_a$ be a sheaf of commutative monoids on $\mathcal C/U_a$ with a homomorphism $\alpha_a:F_a\to R|_{U_a}$. Suppose monoid-sheaf isomorphisms $\phi_{ab}:F_a|_{U_a\times_UU_b}\to F_b|_{U_a\times_UU_b}$ commute with these maps to $R$. Let $F$ be an already given sheaf of sets on $\mathcal C/U$, with set-sheaf isomorphisms $e_a:F|_{U_a}\to |F_a|$ satisfying $e_b=\phi_{ab}e_a$ on every double overlap, including repeated indices. Then there is a unique commutative monoid structure on each $F(V\to U)$, with all restriction maps monoid homomorphisms, for which every $e_a$ is a monoid-sheaf isomorphism. There is a unique monoid-sheaf homomorphism $\alpha:F\to R$ such that $\alpha|_{U_a}=\alpha_a e_a$ for every $a$.

proof.text: Apply lem-trf-monoid-sheaf-local-operations to obtain natural mul and one with the required local formulas. This is done without R or alpha.

For each V→U use the covering objects V_a=V×_U X_a, presented over U through X_a. Mathlib Sieve.overEquiv_ofArrows, ofArrows_eq_pullback_of_isPullback and J.pullback_stable prove that their arrows form a covering in J.over U. The set-sheaf hom_ext_ofArrows theorem, tested on maps out of PUnit, proves that sections are equal if their restrictions to all V_a agree. After applying each e_a the same tests remain injective.

The joint tests carry mul to multiplication in A_a and one to 1. Test both sides of associativity, commutativity, one_mul and mul_one. Their images agree by the local commutative monoid laws, so the tests prove all four laws. Construct the CommMonoid on each original section set, retaining the restriction equations. For any competing family, its natural multiplication and the local formula have the same images under all joint tests. Thus the multiplications agree. Mathlib CommMonoid.ext gives equality of the structures, including powers; the reverse implication is the already proved restriction and local formulas.

Forget R to its set sheaf using sheafCompose and the limit-preserving forgetful functor. Define s_a=alpha_a e_a as a natural map of underlying presheaves. Its overlap condition follows by rewriting with he and hphi. Apply lem-trf-over-sheaf-map-gluing to obtain the unique beta with the required local formulas.

By naturality of beta, restrict the image of a product to each V_a. The glued multiplication formula, beta local formula, multiplicativity of e_a and alpha_a, and multiplicativity of R restrictions identify it with the restricted product of the images. Repeat for 1. Separatedness of the underlying set sheaf of R proves both preservation equations globally. Any beta satisfying the conclusion has the local formulas, so map-gluing uniqueness identifies it with beta. The original Lean statement is unchanged.

lean.statement: theorem monoidSheafStructureGluing {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [HasPullbacks C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C) {I : Type (max u v w)} (U : C) (X : I → C) (f : ∀ a, X a ⟶ U) (hcov : Sieve.ofArrows X f ∈ J U) (R : Sheaf (J.over U) CommMonCat.{max u v w}) (A : ∀ a, Sheaf (J.over (X a)) CommMonCat.{max u v w}) (alpha : ∀ a, A a ⟶ (J.overMapPullback CommMonCat (f a)).obj R) (phi : ∀ a b, (J.overMapPullback CommMonCat (pullback.fst (f a) (f b))).obj (A a) ≅ (J.overMapPullback CommMonCat (pullback.snd (f a) (f b))).obj (A b)) (hphi : ∀ (a b : I) (V : Over (pullback (f a) (f b))) (x : (A a).obj.obj (op ((Over.map (pullback.fst (f a) (f b))).obj V))), R.obj.map ((monoidGluingOverlapIso (f a) (f b)).hom.app V).op ((alpha b).hom.app _ ((phi a b).hom.hom.app (op V) x)) = (alpha a).hom.app _ x) (F : Sheaf (J.over U) (Type (max u v w))) (e : ∀ a, (Over.map (f a)).op ⋙ F.obj ≅ (A a).obj ⋙ forget CommMonCat) (he : ∀ (a b : I) (V : Over (pullback (f a) (f b))) (x : F.obj.obj (op ((Over.map (pullback.snd (f a) (f b)) ⋙ Over.map (f b)).obj V))), (e b).hom.app _ x = (phi a b).hom.hom.app (op V) ((e a).hom.app _ (F.obj.map ((monoidGluingOverlapIso (f a) (f b)).hom.app V).op x))) : ∃ M : ∀ V : (Over U)ᵒᵖ, CommMonoid (F.obj.obj V), (∀ M' : ∀ V : (Over U)ᵒᵖ, CommMonoid (F.obj.obj V), ((∀ (V W : (Over U)ᵒᵖ) (k : V ⟶ W) (x y : F.obj.obj V), F.obj.map k ((M' V).mul x y) = (M' W).mul (F.obj.map k x) (F.obj.map k y)) ∧ (∀ (V W : (Over U)ᵒᵖ) (k : V ⟶ W), F.obj.map k (M' V).one = (M' W).one)) ∧ ((∀ (a : I) (V : (Over (X a))ᵒᵖ) (x y : F.obj.obj ((Over.map (f a)).op.obj V)), (e a).hom.app V ((M' _).mul x y) = (e a).hom.app V x * (e a).hom.app V y) ∧ (∀ (a : I) (V : (Over (X a))ᵒᵖ), (e a).hom.app V (M' _).one = 1)) ↔ M' = M) ∧ ∃! beta : F.obj ⟶ R.obj ⋙ forget CommMonCat, ((∀ (V : (Over U)ᵒᵖ) (x y : F.obj.obj V), beta.app V ((M V).mul x y) = beta.app V x * beta.app V y) ∧ (∀ V : (Over U)ᵒᵖ, beta.app V (M V).one = 1)) ∧ (∀ (a : I) (V : (Over (X a))ᵒᵖ) (x : F.obj.obj ((Over.map (f a)).op.obj V)), beta.app _ x = (alpha a).hom.app V ((e a).hom.app V x))
